title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Bibliothèque Nationale de France, Egyptien 186–194 (AKU HT 20188)

object.name: Paris, Bibliothèque Nationale de France, Egyptien 186–194

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 20188

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 20188; AKU grapheme J0020 (AKU GR 747). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Aa2 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 582. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 56, no. 582. Occurrence: line 6; find place Theben West; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "rot"; sign size 5.7 x 5.7 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Mittleres Reich, 12. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
